title: Umineko: The Witch in the Hall
alt: In a dark hall at night a man in a white jacket points up at a golden figure of a woman on the stairs. Golden butterflies fly out of a large portrait above the stairs and make the shape of the woman. Lightning shows in a tall window, and the floor has black and white squares.
summary: A painting of a scene from Umineko When They Cry in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the hall of the Ushiromiya mansion on the island of Rokkenjima, from Umineko When They Cry, a visual novel by 07th Expansion. A typhoon is over the island. The portrait of the Golden Witch Beatrice hangs above the stairs.
Battler does not believe in witches, and he points at her to deny her. Golden butterflies come out of the portrait and make her shape on the stairs. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
